# CouchLoom

Multi-vault CouchDB/Obsidian LiveSync knowledge service for AI agents.

## Stable endpoints

- GET /health: process liveness
- GET /ready: vault and RAG dependency readiness
- POST /mcp: authenticated MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint

## MCP contract

Call list_vaults first. Pass vault_id to every note and search operation.
Available tools: list_vaults, list_folders, list_tags, list_notes, read_note,
get_note_metadata, search_notes, get_index_status, write_note, edit_note.
Deletion and moving are intentionally unavailable.

## Configuration

Prefer VAULTS_CONFIG_FILE pointing to a JSON array conforming to
docs/vaults.schema.json. RAG requires DATABASE_URL, EMBEDDING_BASE_URL,
EMBEDDING_MODEL, and EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS. MCP_AUTH_TOKEN enables bearer/OAuth
authentication.

Clone normally; this repository has no Git submodules. Generate a bearer token
with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Store the same secret as MCP_AUTH_TOKEN for
CouchLoom and COUCHLOOM_MCP_TOKEN for OpenClaw, outside Git in mode-0600
environment files. OpenClaw uses transport `streamable-http` at `/mcp`.

LiveSync compatibility source is owned in-tree at
packages/core/lib/livesync-commonlib, imported from upstream commit
50d4ab9c1a7d4f59ab29c7555b8dfb2d69555e92.

## Multi-vault behavior

CouchLoom does not auto-discover CouchDB databases. Add each vault explicitly
to the runtime `VAULTS_CONFIG_FILE` array with a unique stable `vault_id`, a
dedicated CouchDB database, and matching LiveSync encryption settings. Restart
the server after changes, then verify `list_vaults`, `get_index_status`, and
`search_notes` for the new ID. Each vault has an independent `_changes`
checkpoint, metadata namespace, and pgvector namespace.
